gap_statement: Cross-stage contestability across making and evaluation lacks direct empirical characterisation.
scope: HCI speculative-design evaluation of visual micro-speculations and AI-mediated revision workflows.
boundary_language: The project does not claim that no prior work studies contestability; innovation comparison remains partial.
notes: The CFP and prior work establish the problem space, not novelty of this exact integration.

gap_statement: Closed correctness-oriented rubrics may measure a different construct from interpretive openness in speculative artefacts.
scope: Evaluation protocols applied to the three Study B artefact families and intended audiences.
boundary_language: CAC is local motivating evidence of construct mismatch, not evidence about speculative ambiguity.

gap_statement: A controlled and auditable apparatus is needed to manipulate revision locality without provider randomness.
scope: Fixed-candidate local experiment with three briefs and two editing representations.
boundary_language: No claim of ecological equivalence to live provider systems.
notes: The implemented apparatus partially closes the engineering gap.

gap_statement: Technical integrity, provenance, audience interpretation, and curatorial retention are often collapsed or treated as substitutable.
scope: Cross-stage warrant recording for the implemented study and expert audit.
boundary_language: No universal five-class evidence framework is claimed.
notes: Needs literature comparison and human conflict cases.
